overview: You saved a view of John Heminges's chalk reckoning slate at Holywell breaking down the twenty-pound Greenwich warrant into expenses and eight equal parts of thirty-seven shillings and sixpence.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Kept a capture of Heminges's chalk cast at Holywell.

parties.name: John Heminges
parties.context: Cast the twenty-pound Chamber warrant into eight equal parts on the slate.

parties.name: James Burbage
parties.context: Hosted the midday reckoning at his house in Holywell.

parties.name: Edith Kettlewood
parties.context: Eight shillings set aside for her from the stock part, payable Thursday.
